title: KSIAM Fall Conference 2026
subtitle: Four student poster presentations in Jeju.

sections.text: MLFE Lab participated in the 2026 Korean Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics (KSIAM) Annual Meeting, held at Jeju Convention Center from November 5 to 8. Seungho Na, Yoonyoung Byun, Hojin Ko, and Dongwan Shin presented their research in the poster sessions.
sections.html: MLFE Lab participated in the 2026 Korean Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics (KSIAM) Annual Meeting, held at Jeju Convention Center from November 5 to 8. Seungho Na, Yoonyoung Byun, Hojin Ko, and Dongwan Shin presented their research in the poster sessions.

sections.text: Hojin Ko presented “Knowing When Not to Trade: Latent No-Trade Region Recovery Hidden in Neural Control,” and Dongwan Shin presented “Discounted Alpha: A Machine Learning Framework for Equity Valuation.”
